test_title: PYST 47: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8493ce33f20b4dfed328745480df8f11482abdabb9a2732ddff21611c2eba66a.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: TVW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c2eaa6aa4199786508eadbc6ad8f96218cf08d6933b823083e7bdbc1d1955da.png] 

Option 2: OQR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/458aac5ea9339a8522738cfaacdba63977ad80cfc6008f85f9c9900194a6d5d6.png] 

Option 3: BEE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bcea8a4e3a0c1821346f29b9414053019a1509db1023cd27e72655286b76aa1.png] 

Option 4: EGH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41ab3ec7496340d5aae9aab578770aabc4ae4384e55f771a156be865a5a96473.png] 

Thus, BEE does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 3.**
